name: SharpTS
file_count_note: TypeScript interpreter + IL compiler implemented in C# (net10.0). Created 2026 (post Jan-2026 model cutoff), MIT, ~1572 meaningful files -> ABOVE the 500-900 target (accepted tradeoff: it is the only viable post-cutoff non-Go repo with a clean .NET toolchain and a real test surface). Tasks are scoped to the core subprojects: Parsing, Compilation, Runtime, TypeSystem, Execution. Black-box: build SharpTS.csproj then run `dotnet bin/Release/net10.0/SharpTS.dll prog.ts`. Always pass -p:MinVerVersionOverride=0.0.0-tb so the build does not depend on git history (the harness strips .git from the workspace).
